licenses.spdx_identification: NOT_ATTEMPTED -- identifying a license from its body text is a judgement this tool does not make; the notices are hashed and kept with the copy, and the SPDX claim stays UNRESOLVED until a human records it

deviations: DEV-T4[dreamcoder]: 1 submodule(s) declare a `branch` in .gitmodules. A branch is not a pin; the commit recorded in `pins` is what was actually fetched.

manifest_entry.named_consumer: H0/H2 reference library-learning arm (comparison only). NOT a scientific-run dependency.
manifest_entry.integration_path: isolated reproduction environment; frozen-library producer first; offline only
manifest_entry.absent_recipe_warning: The README references docs/official_experiments. The design records it as ABSENT from the inspected docs listing. Do NOT claim that recipe was found, and do NOT substitute an invented benchmark number.

upstream_revision.note: master has not moved since 2022-03-16; last push 2023-07-01. No release tags. Immutable revision = this commit sha, pinned explicitly rather than by branch name. Submodules must be pinned at this revision.

budget_profile.purpose: clone a repository tool at a pinned revision with submodules, and build a native toolchain in its OWN environment. Never the live interpreter.
budget_profile.rationale: 8 GiB RSS is 60 percent of measured AVAILABLE RAM -- deliberately under it. 8 of 16 logical CPUs leaves the other half for the seats sharing the host. 2 hours is a ceiling, not a target; the design's warning that 'a long README command is never a license for an unbounded run' is enforced by this number, not by the README.
budget_profile.NOT_A_REPRODUCTION_PROFILE: A published benchmark gets its own explicit profile. This one only builds.
budget_profile.name: isolated_heavy_build

resource_receipt.rss_enforcement: NOT ENFORCED -- no job object / cgroup cap. peak_rss_bytes_os_counter is the OS peak-working-set counter for this process and IS reliable; rss_ceiling_exceeded_during_sampling is sampled and can miss a spike. Neither stops a step.
resource_receipt.rss_excludes_children: This is THIS process only. pip, git and venv run as children and their RSS is NOT included.
